placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Queen Square provides a grassy space among Bristol's city streets. It works particularly well for a packed lunch during a day that already includes the harbour or nearby museums.

Our family idea: bring a compact picnic and enjoy a short people-watching break. Afterwards, walk around the square together and notice the shapes of the surrounding buildings before continuing your day.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families wanting a short picnic stop in the city centre.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Public green space, with city-centre shops and refreshments nearby.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use public transport or city-centre car parks; check restrictions on surrounding streets.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: This is an urban square rather than an enclosed play park. Keep children away from surrounding roads and check for event-related access changes.
